verdict.headline: 1 problem needs your decision before this is ready
verdict.detail: CodeRabbit finished its review and found three things. You have already decided two of them. One real problem is still waiting. Nothing has been changed yet.

findings.title: The totals table does not match the list
findings.meaning: The map says there are 40 skills, but one skill is listed twice, so the real number is 39. Anyone relying on the totals would be misled.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate skill so the count is right.
findings.technical: Duplicate entry 'source-check' in two subsections. CodeRabbit severity: Major.

findings.title: Two agents sound like they do the same job
findings.meaning: The Editor and the Polisher both say they tighten text. The router may not know which to pick.
findings.fix: Reword the Polisher so it only handles final surface checks.

findings.title: A heading uses a different style from the others
findings.fix: Change the heading to match the rest.
findings.note: You said: leave it, the README is being rewritten.

passed.label: No long dashes
passed.detail: Only hyphens are used in the changed lines.

passed.label: No passwords, keys, or email addresses
passed.detail: Nothing that looks like one was added.

passed.label: No leftover merge markers
passed.detail: No unfinished merge text was left in the files.

passed.label: Fits with the main version
passed.detail: GitHub says this can be merged without clashing with the main version of the project.
